value.rationale: The primary paper uses the stretched family to exhibit the first breakdown of a sharp low-complexity palindrome criterion. The new theorem determines how long the breakdown persists, the exact length of the subsequent restoration, and the earliest renewed breakdown for an entire infinite parameter family. These lengths scale with M and expose structural return-word behavior, not an arbitrary isolated constant.
